violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Cleaned and Sanitized Between Each Use (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Cleaned and Sanitized Between Each Use
violation_type.typical_finding: Two sippy cups appeared to have some sort of bacteria (black dots) inside the cup.

finding_variants.text: Two sippy cups appeared to have some sort of bacteria (black dots) inside the cup.
The operation failed to clean and sanitize the bottles and training cup properly.
Based on the information gathered, a caregiver did not clean and sanitize the same cup used for milk prior to serving drinking water to a child in care.
A child's cup was not washed between uses. Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregivers were disciplined.
The caregivers were not sanitizing cups and bottles in between use.   The cups and bottles are washed in the classroom but are not sanitized.
